title: A header a section inherits keeps the layout of the declaring section: the portrait pct table still wraps to two lines on the landscape page, while a landscape section's own copy spans its column in one line
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-28), pymupdf: margins 720, header 720, Calibri 11; page 1 (portrait) header right cell at x 306.48 wraps 'DOCUMENT EVALUATION DU PROGRAMME DE / FORMATION' (baselines 46.56/60.00), body glyph top 76.37; page 2 (landscape, inherited header) identical: x 306.48, two lines, body 76.37; page 3 (landscape, own header) right cell at x 396.48, one line, body 62.93

cases.note: 36 header distance + two Calibri 11 lines + the body line's leading; gen lays the portrait header title on one line (body top 65.74pt) where Word wraps to two

inherited header keeps the portrait width: still two lines; gen 78.27pt: the inherited part wraps to two lines here although the same part is one line on the portrait page, and header tables carry ~2.8pt of extra strip height
own header spans the landscape column: one line; gen 65.75pt: one line like Word, but 2.8pt lower (table strip height)
gen 0: page 1 is already one line in gen
